# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 3 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Penance in the Rivers

---

**1** Adam said to Eve: 'Let us do penance so that God will take pity on us. Maybe he will let us back into paradise, or at least give us food — our souls are crushed with grief.'

**2** 'What penance should we do?' Eve asked. Adam said: 'Let us stand in the water and fast. Perhaps God will forgive us.'

**3** 'You go into the Tigris River and stand in it up to your neck for thirty-seven days. I will go into the Jordan and stand there forty days. I have sinned more than you — the fall came through me.'

**4** Eve went to the Tigris River as Adam had instructed, and Adam went to the Jordan.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
